profile.name: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai
profile.summary: Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai is a private business school with a residential campus at Manamai in Tamil Nadu. Its portfolio serves graduates, experienced professionals, family-business applicants and researchers. Applicants should compare each programme’s awarded credential, experience requirement and delivery format rather than treating every route as an MBA.
profile.campusLifestyle: The residential campus is at Manamai on the East Coast Road in Chengalpattu district. It is distinct from both the Chennai city office and Great Lakes Gurgaon. Full-time residential programmes, executive modules and online study have different attendance expectations.
profile.hostelOverview: PGPM and PGDM are residential programmes. The PGPM fee page includes accommodation and states that single air-conditioned rooms are subject to availability, with an adjustment for twin sharing. Executive-programme boarding and lodging are separately charged.
profile.dietarySupport: The PGPM fee page includes vegetarian meals in its accommodation charges and states that non-vegetarian meals cost extra. Do not assume that this arrangement covers every programme or any particular allergy or medical diet.
whyChoose: AACSB Business accreditation is confirmed in the accreditor’s own Chennai listing.
Different formats serve graduates, experienced professionals and research applicants.
Official fee pages distinguish programme charges from accommodation and deposits.
thingsToConsider: PGPM awards a certificate, not an MBA degree.
The Chennai residential campus is in Manamai, not the central city office or Gurgaon.
Applications must be initiated directly by the applicant; Great Lakes does not authorize intermediaries to do this.
bestFitFor: Graduates comparing a two-year PGDM with the experience-led PGPM route.
Experienced professionals able to meet executive module attendance requirements.
Family-business applicants who meet the programme’s business-registration criteria.

faq.question: Is this the Chennai or Gurgaon institution?
faq.answer: This profile concerns Great Lakes Chennai. Its residential campus is in Manamai, Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu; the official contact page separately identifies its city office.

faq.question: Does the PGPM award an MBA?
faq.answer: The official PGPM FAQ identifies the awarded credential as a Post Graduate Certificate in Management. A comparison with a one-year MBA does not change the award title.

faq.question: Who is the PGPM intended for?
faq.answer: The 2027–28 admissions criteria require at least 24 months of full-time post-graduation work experience by 30 April 2027, alongside the stated academic and test requirements.

faq.question: Can fresh graduates consider PGDM?
faq.answer: Yes. The 2027–29 PGDM admissions route covers fresh graduates and applicants with fewer than 36 months of work experience by 30 May 2027, subject to its academic and test criteria.

faq.question: Which tests are accepted for PGPM?
faq.answer: The current admissions page lists GMAT, CAT, XAT and NMAT with cycle-specific validity rules. Applicants should check the exact test dates and year accepted for their application cycle.

faq.question: Are international applicants charged differently for PGPM?
faq.answer: The PGPM FAQ accepts foreign applicants subject to programme criteria and a conditional English-language test requirement. Its 2027–28 fee table distinguishes domestic INR and international USD schedules; confirm your fee category with admissions.

faq.question: Are PGDM fees annual?
faq.answer: The reviewed PGDM fee table is for the complete 2026–28 programme. Its whole-course tuition and residential charges should not be presented as an annual quote or as a confirmed 2027–29 tariff.

faq.question: What distinguishes the family-business programme?
faq.answer: This one-year residential family-business and entrepreneurship route awards a Post Graduate Certificate in Management. The admission criteria reference a business registered under Indian law. The published immersion-charge discrepancy should be clarified before payment.

faq.question: Can StudentsTraffic submit the application for me?
faq.answer: Great Lakes states that it does not authorize third parties to initiate applications on applicants’ behalf. Counselling can help compare fit, but applicants should complete the official application directly.

faq.question: Is online PGDM the same delivery format as residential PGDM?
faq.answer: No. The online PGDM page describes a two-year online programme with an optional campus-immersion version. Confirm the enrolling institution and the selected variant before paying.

faq.question: What does AACSB confirm?
faq.answer: AACSB’s own directory lists Great Lakes Institute of Management Chennai with Business accreditation. That listing is institution-specific and should not be used to claim that an unrelated campus or every certificate holds a separate programme accreditation.

profile.cityProfile: The Chennai institution’s residential campus is at Manamai on the East Coast Road in Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu. Its official contact page separately lists a Chennai city office. Students planning residence or campus-module travel should use the Manamai campus address and distinguish it from the Gurgaon institution.
profile.practicalExposure: The PGXPM describes a faculty-guided capstone based on a business problem from the participant’s organization, alongside executive coaching and on-campus modules. The FPM describes research mentorship and an optional, separately selected international doctoral track. These programme-specific opportunities should not be presented as a guaranteed internship or job for every student.
profile.safetyOverview: The Chennai mandatory-disclosure page publishes an anti-ragging committee and a policy against sexual harassment. A separate grievance page explains how students can raise a service request through the CAMU learning platform. These are reporting mechanisms, not guarantees about incident prevention or response times.
profile.studentSupport: The Chennai grievance system provides a CAMU helpdesk route for students to select a problem category and raise a service request. PGPM applicants can also seek a prior appointment for a campus visit through the admissions team; access and arrangements should be confirmed before travel.
